title: Pan-Seared Galette with Garlic Rice
description: A flavorful, French-inspired dish featuring crispy galette and savory garlic-infused rice.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add rice and stir for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water or broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes until water is absorbed.
While rice cooks, preheat a pan or griddle over medium-high heat.
Add galette slices and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until crispy and golden.
Serve garlic rice with pan-seared galette and garnish with chopped parsley.
